name: 911 Inspection Dimensions
description: Reads every PART SKETCH drawing in a batch and fills each part's dimensions and weld-prep bevel angles onto its inspection sheet
author: Anthony Sieben

setup: Set the batch up first (911 Setup) so each nest workbook already has its inspection sheet tabs.
Nothing else to install - the drawing reader is built into TechDeck.
how_it_works: Point it at a batch folder, one nest folder, or just a folder of nest package PDFs.
Finds the PART SKETCH pages and reads the drawing picture on each one.
Picks out every dimension - lengths, radii (R .40), diameters, angles, chamfers and snipes like .50 X .50.
Types those numbers into the matching part's inspection sheet tab, in the colour-filled TARGET boxes. Excel works out MIN and MAX from each one on its own.
TYP dimensions go in LAST. The drawing prints them once but the feature repeats and never says how many times, so copy the last ones across as many times as the part needs.
Anything marked REF is left out, and so are numbers that are part of a note on the drawing. Both are listed in the report so you can see them.
A tab that already has numbers typed in is never touched.

Weld preps (the KB/SB/FB/WB bevel codes) are looked up in the Electric Boat bevel book and their bevel angle goes on the sheet too - one entry per side the drawing names, so "KB114 NS & FS" writes two.
A bevel code that has been VOIDed writes nothing and is listed with the code that replaces it, so a retired bevel never lands on an inspection sheet.
output: The inspection sheet tabs in each nest workbook, filled in and ready to review.
One text file in the folder you picked listing every part, its dimensions, its weld preps, and exactly what was written to which tab.
Anything the reader was unsure about is flagged with CHECK so you can eyeball it against the drawing.

fields.label: Default folder
fields.description: Folder the pick-a-folder dialog opens in. Leave blank to start wherever you were last.

fields.label: Dry run (don't change any workbook)
fields.description: Read the drawings and write the report, but leave every nest workbook untouched. Use it to see what would be filled in before letting it write.

fields.label: Sentry Drone mode
fields.description: Pick the file or folder through the targeting-drone kill-cam - crosshair cursor, lock-on, and a railgun strike on the target. Off = a normal Explorer dialog. Buy the Sentry Drone at Woogy's Emporium; set every app at once from My Stuff.
